name: template-resize
title_zh: 一个 8x8 模板改出整条尺寸线，版式不重排
tagline_zh: 做相册、帆布画、墙面装饰的人最怕客户临时换尺寸：4x6 改 5x7 就得手工挪一遍版式。
tagline_en: Client swaps 4x6 for 5x7 and you'd normally re-lay every page. This derives the whole size range from one seed.
desc_en: Use when resizing, retargeting, cloning or deriving a Pixfizz design product to a different size, or when generating a whole size range from one seed export — a photo book, album, canvas wrap, wall product, print or any template with pages. Triggers on "resize this template", "turn the 8x8 into a 10x10", "make a 5x7 from the 4x6", "the layouts are the wrong size", "derive the other sizes", "build
why_zh: 不是等比缩放图片，而是按模板结构重算每个尺寸的版面参数，所以派生出来的每一档都是可继续编辑的原生模板。
why_en: It recomputes layout parameters per size instead of scaling pixels, so every derived size stays an editable native template.
limit_zh: 只对 Pixfizz 自家模板结构生效，PSD、Canva、Figma 文件喂进去它不认；派生结果停在模板层。
limit_en: Only works on Pixfizz template structures — PSD, Canva or Figma files won't parse. Output stops at the template layer: no export, no print file, and.
title_en: Resize one Pixfizz template into a whole size range
